@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+//go:build !scanner
+
+package models
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	cvedict "github.com/vulsio/go-cve-dictionary/models"
+)
+
+func TestConvertNvdToModelCvss40(t *testing.T) {
+	const cveID = "CVE-2024-5732"
+	const nvdSource = "nvd@nist.gov"
+	const vendorSource = "vendor@example.com"
+	cves, _, _ := ConvertNvdToModel(cveID, []cvedict.Nvd{{
+		Descriptions: []cvedict.NvdDescription{{Value: "Description"}},
+		Cvss3: []cvedict.NvdCvss3{{
+			Source: nvdSource,
+			Cvss3:  cvedict.Cvss3{BaseScore: 7.3},
+		}},
+		Cvss40: []cvedict.NvdCvss40{
+			{
+				Source: nvdSource,
+				Cvss40: cvedict.Cvss40{
+					BaseScore: 8.7, VectorString: "CVSS:4.0/AV:N", BaseSeverity: "HIGH",
+				},
+			},
+			{
+				Source: vendorSource,
+				Cvss40: cvedict.Cvss40{
+					BaseScore: 5.3, VectorString: "CVSS:4.0/AV:L", BaseSeverity: "MEDIUM",
+				},
+			},
+		},
+	}})
+	if len(cves) != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("got %d contents, want 2", len(cves))
+	}
+	bySource := make(map[string]CveContent, len(cves))
+	for _, cve := range cves {
+		bySource[cve.Optional["source"]] = cve
+	}
+	for source, want := range map[string]struct {
+		score    float64
+		vector   string
+		severity string
+		cvss3    float64
+	}{
+		nvdSource:    {8.7, "CVSS:4.0/AV:N", "HIGH", 7.3},
+		vendorSource: {5.3, "CVSS:4.0/AV:L", "MEDIUM", 0},
+	} {
+		got, ok := bySource[source]
+		if !ok {
+			t.Errorf("missing content for source %q", source)
+			continue
+		}
+		if got.Type != Nvd || got.CveID != cveID || got.Cvss40Score != want.score || got.Cvss40Vector != want.vector || got.Cvss40Severity != want.severity || got.Cvss3Score != want.cvss3 {
+			t.Errorf("source %q: got %+v, want CVSS 4.0 %+v", source, got, want)
+		}
+	}
+}
